Bottle change.formula:
SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Month) = YEAR(Reporting_Month) AND MONTH(Month) <= MONTH(Reporting_Month)
  THEN IFNULL(Retail_Bottles_Sold, 0) + IFNULL(Wholesale_Bottles_Sold, 0) ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Month) = YEAR(Reporting_Month) - 1 AND MONTH(Month) <= MONTH(Reporting_Month)
  THEN IFNULL(Retail_Bottles_Sold, 0) + IFNULL(Wholesale_Bottles_Sold, 0) ELSE 0 END)

Bottle data status.formula: CASE Coverage_Status WHEN "AWAITING_CERTIFIED_HISTORY" THEN "History pending" WHEN "PRIOR_YEAR_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE" THEN "Prior year pending" WHEN "PARTIAL_HISTORY" THEN CONCAT("Through ", FORMAT_DATETIME("%b %Y", Reporting_Month), " (partial)") WHEN "READY" THEN CONCAT("Through ", FORMAT_DATETIME("%b %Y", Reporting_Month)) ELSE "Check history status" END
